title: A closed checkout funnel
steps: In the Google Merchandise Store property, open Explore and start a Funnel exploration. It is a personal exploration: Viewer access allows it, and it changes nothing in the property.
Edit the funnel's steps so there are four, in this order, each the event of that name: view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout, purchase.
Keep the funnel closed: the open funnel setting stays off.
Set the date range. On a first answer, choose Last 28 days and type the dates GA4 shows into From and To. On a re-check, use the dates the app shows.
Read the users at each step and each step's abandonment rate.

parts.question: Which step has the largest abandonment rate, that is, the step users most often leave the funnel after?

parts.label: Step 1 users
parts.question: How many users are at step 1 (view_item)?

parts.label: Step 2 users
parts.question: How many users are at step 2 (add_to_cart)?
In a GA4 funnel exploration, what makes a funnel closed rather than open?
options: Users must finish every step in one session
Users are counted from whichever step they enter the funnel at
Every step must be an event marked as a key event
Users are counted only if they enter the funnel at step 1
